# template

Types from PocketBase's Go package `template`, as JavaScript sees them: you get these objects from [`$app` and the other globals](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and from hook events, and call their methods by their JS names (Go's `FindRecordById` is `findRecordById`). The same package in Go: [template](/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/template).

## template.Registry

Registry defines a templates registry that is safe to be used by multiple goroutines.

Use the Registry.Load* methods to load templates into the registry.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `addFuncs()` | <code>(funcs: { [key: string]: any }): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/template#templateregistry">Registry</a>)</code> | AddFuncs registers new global template functions. |
| `loadFiles()` | <code>(...filenames: string[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/template#templaterenderer">Renderer</a>)</code> | LoadFiles caches (if not already) the specified filenames set as a single template and returns a ready to use Renderer instance. |
| `loadString()` | <code>(text: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/template#templaterenderer">Renderer</a>)</code> | LoadString caches (if not already) the specified inline string as a single template and returns a ready to use Renderer instance. |
| `loadFS()` | <code>(fsys: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/fs#fsfs">fs.FS</a>, ...globPatterns: string[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/template#templaterenderer">Renderer</a>)</code> | LoadFS caches (if not already) the specified fs and globPatterns pair as single template and returns a ready to use Renderer instance. |

## template.Renderer

Renderer defines a single parsed template.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `render()` | <code>(data: any): string</code> | Render executes the template with the specified data as the dot object and returns the result as plain string. |
